page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines; an engraving with its motto in the centre; imprint below the engraving; a library oval stamp and a digitiser's credit at the edges (not transcribed).

main_text.l: S.S. Litterarum in Ecclesiâ, & Academiae Lugduno-Batavâ Doctore.

page.notes: The Hebrew line is printed in red and is copied as far as legible; the engraving shows a phoenix in flames under the motto "EX MORTE IMMORTALITAS". The date line is printed in old numeral form: CIↃ IↃ C LV, i.e. MDCLV. The oval library stamp ("Biblioteca Nazionale ... Vittorio Emanuele") overlaps the author line and is not transcribed. The imprint "Ex Officinâ" and "PETRI LEFFEN" are set in mixed type; "Academiae" is partly obscured by the stamp.
